searchText: An update from nethermind side(master, not released yet): - discovery: we remade disc v4 and v5, enabled both on mainnet and v5 only hoodi,sepolia; added fork info in enrs; planning to test topic based discovery, if you are aware of better idea than looking for peers by topic = keccak(rlp([fork_hash, fork_next])), please let us know; - sparse blobs is still a working draft, we are testing against geth and (vibecoded) lighthouse
